info.title: Five Common Causes of Hearing Problems
info.subtitle: What tends to be behind hearing trouble, and how each one shows up

rows.title: Aging
rows.desc: Gradual high-pitch loss as inner-ear cells wear down

rows.title: Noise exposure
rows.desc: Loud sound permanently damages the inner ear

rows.title: Earwax buildup
rows.desc: A blockage that muffles sound, and is reversible

rows.title: Infection or fluid
rows.desc: Inflammation behind the eardrum dampens hearing

rows.title: Medications
rows.desc: Some drugs can affect hearing, temporarily or for good
